name: HanJung Natural Connectivity System.co.,Ltd
summary: HanJung Natural Connectivity System Co., Ltd. is primarily involved in the production and distribution of components for the automotive sector. Its extensive range of offerings includes brake levers, pedal units, vehicle doors, weight classification systems, engine mounting brackets, lighting fixtures, spare wheel sub-assemblies, various electronic parts, and exhaust system components. The firm was established on August 31, 1995, and its corporate headquarters are situated in Yeongcheon-si, South Korea.
